polishes.name: Aqua Ghost
polishes.description: Swatches are shown over white. This glow in the dark nail polish is meant to be a topper not a full opacity color. You can apply one or two coats over any color. Some top coats block uv lights and will affect these polishes. These can be charged with the sun. This one might have some fallen pigments at the bottom, this does not affect the polish, there is no need to shake it. • Not all GID pigments glow with the same intensity & for the same length of time The intensity is based on the wavelength the color gives off. Yellow, green, white, aqua: glow the brightest and longest Red, dark orange, pink, blue, violet, purple: less bright and shorter glow time as they are on the ends of the visible color spectrum It needs top coat, otherwise will dry down matte or slightly gritty/textured. Glow time and brightness varies between each glow in the dark topper. The longer you charge your nails, the longer the glow may last. We strongly recommend a uv/blacklight for charging your glow polish once on your nails. Glow in the dark polishes will need a good shake or roll to redistribute pigments before use, because they are naturally heavier and will settle over time. Item comes in a glass 15mL bottle with a stainless steel mixing bead. Vegan, cruelty free and 10-free. polishes.name: Pink Ghost
polishes.description: The swatches show 2 coats over Milk Bath This glow in the dark nail polish is meant to be a topper not a full opacity color. You can apply one or two coats over any color. Some top coats block uv lights and will affect these polishes. These can be charged with the sun. • Not all GID pigments glow with the same intensity & for the same length of time The intensity is based on the wavelength the color gives off. Yellow, green, white, aqua: glow the brightest and longest Red, dark orange, pink, blue, violet, purple: less bright and shorter glow time as they are on the ends of the visible color spectrum It needs top coat, otherwise will dry down matte or slightly gritty/textured. Glow time and brightness varies between each glow in the dark topper. The longer you charge your nails, the longer the glow may last. We strongly recommend a uv/blacklight for charging your glow polish once on your nails. Glow in the dark polishes will need a good shake or roll to redistribute pigments before use, because they are naturally heavier and will settle over time. All swatches are representative of the colors as close as possible, however the actual color may appear different depending on your monitors resolution and color settings. 15 mL / 0.5 FL OZ / 10-Free A deep purple jelly base filled with shifting rainbow glitters. A smoothing top coat may help with any texture from the glitter. Swatches provided by myself, @ametrinenails, & @mani_cursed Please Keep In Mind: All of my polishes are mixed by hand in small batches. Please note that screen colors can vary.
